items.title: Ranking-Aware Prompt Optimization for Multimodal Clinical Diagnosis
items.authors: Tian Xia, Minghao Liu, Yiqing Liang et al.
items.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are rapidly advancing clinical diagnosis, yet their adaptation pipelines remain anchored to accuracy-based objectives.
